import re,os
lines=open('docs/CODE-LAYOUT.md').read().split('\n')
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    m=re.match(r'^\| `([a-z0-9\-]+\.js)` \| (.*)$', l)
    if not m: continue
    mod, desc = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    path='src/'+mod
    if not os.path.exists(path): print('NOMOD',mod); continue
    src=open(path).read()
    ids=set(re.findall(r'`([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})`', desc))
    miss=[x for x in ids if x not in src]
    if miss: print(f'{i} {mod}: {sorted(miss)}')
